comment: Fixture corpus manifest for the retrieval eval. bookId is the fake Calibre id; file lives in corpus/. Titles/authors feed the real '[title › authors]' embedding context prefix, so keep them descriptive of the topic — except the #359 raw-title books 125-127, whose title is a raw filename on purpose (authors 'Unknown'; 'realTitle' is for the #363 title-prefix ablation and is never read by the harness). All texts are self-authored for this repo (MIT, deterministic — never regenerate casually: queries.json labels char spans into them). Books with a 'figures' field carry a synthetic figure inventory (figures/*.json) fed through the REAL marker-injection path at eval time (#85/#86); the .txt files stay untouched - markers place via the page-1 fallback.
